title: Final answer audit of MPPSC 2014 Prelims Paper-I

summary.method: Every one of the 100 questions was re-read and answered independently; the printed key was compared with the stored answer; each explanation was rebuilt to a four-part standard (concept and justification, per-option reasoning tied to that option text, revision facts, takeaway). A correction is recorded only where the evidence contradicts the key and another option is demonstrably right; scan damage in option text was repaired only where the printed paper or the paper's own answer set makes the intended wording certain.
